lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance spots are organized in vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with inter-centroid spacing increasing in the posterior direction. The spots form a non-uniform 2D grid against the darker dermis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular spots, creating a lattice where the spots serve as anchor nodes on the vertical striations.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is observed on the upper flank, exhibiting a significant luminance gradient with a highlight on the dorsal edge and a diffuse shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel vertical linear indentations or scars are present, crossing the gill slits and extending onto the anterior lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible presence of several small, elongated organisms (commensal fish) positioned ventrally to the main flank area, near the pectoral fin base.
